thread.title: Warren Buffett Added More Apple Stock In Q2 But Berkshire Hathaway Grew Its Goldman Sachs Stock Stake By 20%

author: APARNA NARAYANAN
title: Warren Buffett Added More Apple Stock In Q2 But Berkshire Hathaway Grew Its Goldman Sachs Stock Stake By 20%

organizations.name: berkshire hathaway grew its goldman sachs stock stake
delta air lines and southwest airlines

text:
Legendary investor Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway ( BRKB ) upped its stake in Apple ( AAPL ), Goldman Sachs ( GS ), Southwest Airlines ( LUV ), Delta Air Lines ( DAL ), U.S. Bancorp ( USB ) and Teva Pharmaceutical ( TEVA ) in the second quarter, according to the latest 13F filing.
X Berkshire Hathaway raised its Apple stock position by 5%, while expanding its Goldman Sachs ( GS ) stock holdings by 20%. Both Apple stock and Goldman stock are Dow Jones components.
The conglomerate raised Delta Air Lines and Southwest Airlines stock holdings by 18% each, but Berkshire trimmed American Airlines ( AAL ) holdings by 2% and United Continental ( UAL ) by 3%.
Berkshire Hathaway slashed its stake in oil refinery operator Phillips 66 ( PSX ) by 23%. Berkshire also entirely dumped its Verisk Analytics ( VRSK ) stock holdings.
